description: This file defines the ADODB_Pager class for handling recordset pagination with navigation links in a PHP application, part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_Pager
classes.description: Class for managing pagination of database recordsets with navigation links in PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the pager with database connection, SQL query, and configuration options.

methods.name: Render_First
methods.description: Displays a link to the first page.

methods.name: render_next
methods.description: Displays a link to the next page.

methods.name: render_last
methods.description: Displays a link to the last page.

methods.name: render_pagelinks
methods.description: Displays page number links for navigation.

methods.name: render_prev
methods.description: Displays a link to the previous page.

methods.name: RenderGrid
methods.description: Renders the current recordset as an HTML grid.

methods.name: RenderNav
methods.description: Renders the navigation bar with pagination links.

methods.name: RenderPageCount
methods.description: Displays the current page number and total pages.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to execute query and render the paginated grid with navigation.

methods.name: RenderLayout
methods.description: Controls overall layout and formatting of the pagination display.
